title: Media
description: Images for your posts. Every file is checked and prepared to suit each platform.

upload.dropzone: Drop images here or choose them
upload.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or still GIF, at most 20 MB per file
upload.storageFailed: The file could not be uploaded to the storage.

rejectReasons.SIZE_MISMATCH: The file has another size than announced.
rejectReasons.TYPE_MISMATCH: The file has another type than announced.
rejectReasons.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: This image format is not supported.
rejectReasons.HEIC_NOT_SUPPORTED: HEIC images are not supported. Please export the image as JPEG.
rejectReasons.DIMENSIONS_TOO_LARGE: The image has too many pixels, at most 50 megapixels.
rejectReasons.CORRUPT_IMAGE: The image is damaged or incomplete.

usage: {count, plural, =0 {Not used} one {Used in # variant} other {Used in # variants}}

empty.title: No media yet
empty.description: Upload images to attach them to posts.

emptyFilter: There are no media for this filter.

altText.label: Alt text
altText.hint: Describes the image for people who cannot see it.
altText.fromLibrary: Left empty, the alt text from the library applies.

delete.title: Delete the file?
delete.description: “{name}” is removed from the library and deleted for good after 30 days.

strip.title: Media
strip.empty: No media are attached to this variant yet.
strip.dragHint: Drag to sort, or move with the space bar and the arrow keys.
strip.needsCrop: Does not fit the aspect ratio of the platform: please crop or choose bars.
strip.libraryAltText: Left empty, the alt text from the library applies: {text}

picker.title: Add media
picker.description: Choose images from the library or upload new ones.

crop.title: Crop for {platform}
crop.description: Move and zoom the section. It applies to this platform only.
crop.letterboxHint: Instead of cropping, the version for the platform adds white bars up to the allowed aspect ratio.
